name: CROSS script
source:
There are two popular male idol rivals. Choose one of them and and enjoy five stories that happened to each of them while remembering to keep stats high to win the competition . 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2018/12/vn-of-month-may-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
两名人气男偶像互为劲敌。选择其中一人，体验发生在他身上的五段故事，同时别忘了维持较高的能力数值，以赢得比赛。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2018/12/vn-of-month-may-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
